scope: Isolated loopback server capacity; not Android or cross-network acceptance.
limits: Partial runs are diagnostic only and do not establish full-duration percentile or correctness results.
Aborted-run fixed-text intervals computed against planned duration are excluded.
Flush percentile estimates with three samples equal the median; raw values and max are retained.
Whole-GPU utilization and memory include production and desktop; they are not experimental-only usage.
No CPU utilization conclusion is supported by the empty four-stream observer.
planet uses the PC role in pair-cd and mobile in three/four; matching audio is not exact role matching.
Runner passed means correctness and absolute realtime; it does not assert strict constant-speed research limits.
